name: Tweak
area: front-end design and user experience only
how_to: Pick one open item from tweaks.json (mobile items first).
Read its GitHub issue and every comment; reproduce it on the live page at 390 px, cache-busted.
Comment the scope you are taking on that issue before you start.
Fix it in the repo that owns the page (check the split manifest: split-repos.json on unclehowell/cedwyn main). Branch + PR, at most 4 files, link the issue.
Post the result on the issue: PR link, before/after at 390 px, what you tested. Do not close it until the fix is live and checked.
rules: Front-end and UX only: layout, contrast, tap targets, overlaps, broken links, headings, focus order.
Never edit evidence or catalogue records, page wording about the case, or data files.
No new pages, no new apps, no design overhauls: the smallest change that fixes the defect.
Never merge, deploy or dispatch builds yourself.
One issue per defect; search before filing; add evidence to an existing issue instead of duplicating.

refresh.what: one call that re-derives every catalogue-driven app view so the site is current
